description: This file contains Jetpack Compose UI components for rendering chat messages in an Android application, including message bubbles, typing indicators, tool notifications, and code blocks for a chat interface.

classes.name: ChatBubbleStyle
classes.description: Data class representing styling options for chat bubbles, including alignment, background color, border color, and role color.

methods.name: ChatMessageBubble
methods.description: Composable function that displays a chat message inside a styled bubble, deciding style based on the role.

methods.name: ChatBubbleContainer
methods.description: Private composable that provides layout and style wrapper for chat bubble content with role label.

methods.name: ChatMessageBody
methods.description: Displays the individual parts of a chat message, including text and images.

methods.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
methods.description: Displays a typing indicator bubble with animated dots.

methods.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
methods.description: Displays a bubble indicating ongoing tool operations with a list of active tools.

methods.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
methods.description: Displays a speech bubble indicating live assistant response.

methods.name: bubbleStyle
methods.description: Determines the style of chat bubbles based on the role.

methods.name: roleLabel
methods.description: Returns a label string based on the role type.

methods.name: ChatBase64Image
methods.description: Displays an image from base64 data within a chat message.

methods.name: DotPulse
methods.description: Displays animated pulsing dots for activity indication.

methods.name: PulseDot
methods.description: Single pulsing dot used within DotPulse.

methods.name: ChatCodeBlock
methods.description: Displays a block of code with optional language header, styled appropriately.
